subject: Intro from Lakeside — Schedule Redwood demo

From: Danielle Myers <d.myers@lakesideconsulting.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Jordan Hall at Acme Energy — exploring inference vendors

Priya / Marissa —

Quick intro: Jordan Hall at Acme Energy is evaluating inference platforms for a proof-of-concept around document processing and customer self-service. Lakeside suggested Redwood based on the lower-latency batch / caching patterns you sketched in the workshop last quarter.

Jordan, meet Priya (SDR/AE partner lead) and Marissa (Solutions Engineer). Priya will coordinate a short technical + product demo to validate performance and integration surface.

Jordan's notes: they completed the self-serve trial last week and have a couple of sample workflows ready. Key asks are: latency at 1–2s p95 on short chat flows, model version pinning, and security options for PII.

Attaching a one-pager from Lakeside that outlines the high-level use case (acme-inbound-brief.pdf). Can you share two 30–45 minute windows next week for an intro demo?

Thanks —
Danielle Myers
Director, Partner Sales
Lakeside Consulting
(415) 555-0182

Hi Jordan — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Danielle for the intro.

Short note to coordinate — we recommend a 40-minute session: 20 minutes demo, 15 minutes Q&A, 5 minutes next steps. Marissa will cover the security/compliance angle and Ben will join for procurement/pricing questions.

A few times that work for our team next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-07-28 10:00–10:40
- Wed 2026-07-29 14:00–14:40
- Thu 2026-07-30 09:30–10:10

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and we will adapt. Also, Jordan, can you confirm whether you'd like us to demo the self-serve flow you tried or focus on an integration with Lakeside's connector? Either is fine.

I'll attach a short agenda and send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
SDR, Redwood Inference
